summary: Master Portfolio Risk Management and Optimization through our expert-led training. Equip yourself with essential tools for effective investment strategies.
lede: Portfolio risk management gives investment professionals a structured way to assess uncertainty and make informed portfolio decisions. For portfolio managers, risk analysts and investment strategists, the course covers quantitative risk assessment using VaR and Conditional VaR, scenario and stress testing, and mitigation through diversification and hedging, as well as monitoring risk-adjusted performance and communicating results to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for optimizing investment portfolios and managing associated risks.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of finance and basic risk management concepts.
